study.title: Applying Knowledge Distillation to Improve Weed Mapping with Drones
study.short_title: Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight ViT Weed Mapping
study.venue: Conference on Computer Science and Information Systems

segmentation.best_model: Lawin-L0 distilled with continuation KD (Rheinbach macro F1 0.863; weed F1 0.736, crop F1 0.862)

dataset.name: WeedMap (sugar beet, Rheinbach DE + Eschikon CH orthomosaics)
dataset.note: Public WeedMap dataset: two UAV multispectral subsets - Rheinbach 5-ch MicaSense RedEdge-M, Eschikon 4-ch Parrot Sequoia; 8 orthomosaic maps reduced to 557 (Rheinbach) / 561 (Eschikon) tiles after black-edge removal, cropped to 256x256. Classes: background, crop (beet), weed.

mIoU.ambiguity: Study reports class-wise and macro-averaged F1; mIoU not reported.

F1.quote: Continuation KD 0.863 ... with an average F1 score of only 0.005 lower than the teacher model
F1.ambiguity: Macro-averaged F1 on Rheinbach subset with continuation KD (best). Per-class Rheinbach continuation-KD: background 0.990, crop 0.862, weed 0.736. Eschikon best (TAKD) macro F1 0.631 (background 0.992, crop 0.763, weed 0.138).

weed_F1.quote: the F1 score for weed class ... 0.001 lower [than the teacher] for the weed class
weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed-class F1 on Rheinbach with continuation KD (teacher 0.737). On Eschikon weed F1 rises from 0.046 (no KD) to 0.138 (TAKD).

crop_F1.quote: the F1 score for crop class showed a significant increase from 0.653 to 0.753
crop_F1.ambiguity: Crop-class F1 Rheinbach continuation-KD 0.862 per Table I (note: Eschikon TAKD crop F1 0.763 in Table I vs 0.753 in running text).

fps.ambiguity: No measured inference FPS/latency on drone hardware; suitability asserted from FLOPs only.

params_M.ambiguity: Lawin-L0 student model parameter count (structural; teacher HRNet+OCR+PSA 75.74M). No field-measured edge deployment.

gflops.ambiguity: Paper reports 0.5 GMacs (giga multiply-accumulate ops) for Lawin-L0; converted as 0.5 GMacs ~ 1.0 GFLOPs (2 FLOPs/MAC); value not directly reported in FLOPs. Teacher = 42.04 GMacs.

issues: Lightweight student constructed for drone deployment but no on-board inference benchmark measured (edge.reported=false; compute reported as structural metrics).
GMacs converted to GFLOPS with factor 2 (value 1.0; underlying unit mismatch noted).
